name: tool-box
description: Report email construction and sending for 3 AXIS / EXCES DE VITESSE / FREINAGE. Fusion AI keeps all analysis (auth, dedup, OBC thresholds, tachograph, screenshot capture, recap/xlsx, Drive update); this service takes the already-analyzed records and builds the email body, builds the multi-page PDF when there's more than one record, and sends via Gmail -- offloading the memory-heavy report-formatting step from Fusion's stateful execution model.
